value.title: Duplicate formatToolArgs function definition
value.detail: terminal-ui.ts defines its own formatToolArgs() function (lines 157-178), but renderer.ts imports the same function from '@cjhyy/code-shell-core' (line 8). This creates two separate implementations that could diverge, leading to maintenance issues and inconsistent behavior.
value.fix: Remove the duplicate function definition from terminal-ui.ts and import it from the core library or the renderer module.
